flags: The vendor's Terms of Service explicitly prohibit HIPAA data use, yet a third party (Nudge Security) claims HIPAA certification. This contradiction casts doubt on the accuracy of third-party claims.

Nudge Security's third-party profile claims SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, PCI, FedRamp, and CSA STAR, none of which appear on the vendor's own domain; there is no trust center, no security pages, and no documentation on the vendor's site to support them.
The advertised privacy policy URL (craftly.ai/privacy-policy.html) returns HTTP 404, so users cannot independently verify privacy practices.
The terms do not explicitly state whether customer content is retained or used for model training, and no clear opt-out is disclosed. Data ownership is explicitly assigned to OpenAI LLC.
There are no dedicated security, trust, compliance, or certifications pages on craftly.ai; all searches for security-related content return zero results.
The company was founded in 2021, is bootstrap-funded, and has 1-10 employees, which is typical of early-stage AI tools with limited compliance infrastructure.
The legal entity is confirmed as 'CraftlyAI Inc.' and 'MNGD LLC' at 626 King St West, Suite 401, Toronto, M5V 1M5, per the homepage footer.
